Relevant metrics include pose repeatability, pose accuracy, path accuracy, velocity and acceleration consistency, and dynamic-response characteristics such as overshoot, drift, and response time. The repeatability protocol requires moving the robot to a predefined target 30 times from the same approach direction, then statistically analyzing the dispersion of the final positions using standard-deviation measures. Vision systems support multi-point, trajectory, and dynamic assessment but require careful calibration and are sensitive to lighting, reflections, occlusion, and processing accuracy.
